notes: Realism is now on by default, all of it: weather, physics, bodies, hygiene, household life, clothes and wet fabric, touch, pacing, menstrual cycles, boredom and schedules apply in every scene.
Off-screen lives follow the core realism rules too.
Settings > Realism: Full (default), Standard (core rules plus details when relevant, uses fewer tokens), or Off.
Your edits to Realism entries in the Lorebook are used, and switching an entry off removes it.
